snippet.title: ASEMA - Official Reveal Trailer - Space Automation & Factory Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist ASEMA on Steam now https://store.steampowered.com/app/4478970/ASEMA/

The machine must grow. You are an ancient artificial entity. Build machines and outposts, connect your production and mining stations, and manage your logistics in this hardcore, physics-based automation simulation game.

Music by https://soundcloud.com/frantic79/sets/asema-official-soundtrack
